scenes.description: The player speaks with a harbormaster at a dockside shop, discussing upgrades for their ship.
The player views the ship upgrade menu, selecting options for hull armor.
The player upgrades the ship's hull armor to level V.
The player sells wine and tobacco at the harbormaster's shop.
The player exits the shop and boards their ship.
The player is in the ship customization menu, viewing the Jackdaw's current state and available upgrades.
The player selects an upgrade option, focusing on enhancing the ship's hull armor.
The player continues to customize the ship's appearance, selecting different figureheads and wheel designs.
The player explores sail options, choosing between different sets of sails for the Jackdaw.
The player finalizes their selection of a new figurehead for the ship.
The player reviews the updated appearance of the Jackdaw with the new figurehead installed.
